premises.text: Kids spend heavy time online and parents worry games and social media hurt development, creating demand for better supplemental learning
premises.evidence_span: kids are spending seven and a half hours a day online. And 75% of parents are really concerned about how games and social media affect their kids' development

premises.text: Cloud-based distributed platform works across devices and structures interaction using developmental science and a proprietary neural algorithmic learning model
premises.evidence_span: Our distributed system technology is cloud-based. It works across all devices and operating systems in real time from anywhere in the world

premises.text: Personalized skill tracking recommends games and offline activities to reinforce weak skill sets while kids play
premises.evidence_span: the skill sets are being tracked and data is being aggregated in a way that is providing really meaningful insights that will really help with personalizing learning

premises.text: Patented cloning and remote in-game coaching lets parents, educators, and family enter the game to collaborate and give progressive hints
premises.evidence_span: a patented cloning technology and remote in-game coaching and mentoring system, where parents, educators, and extended family can actually enter the game and influence the gaming experience of the child

premises.text: Experts and Mentors Network lets parents invite coaches into gameplay and share data for targeted skill development
premises.evidence_span: we're just launching the Experts and Mentors Networks, and this is just a community that, again, that the parents can invite to participate in the game and coach
